strings.zh: 这里是１号道路{NEWLINE}南　真新镇
strings.en: Route 1{NEWLINE}South to Pallet Town

strings.zh: 常磐商店物美价优{NEWLINE}是广大训练师的不二之选！{SCROLL}一定不要错过！
strings.en: Viridian Mart: quality goods at great{NEWLINE}prices!{SCROLL}The top choice for Trainers{NEWLINE}everywhere! Don’t miss it!
strings.notes: 常磐商店 = Viridian Mart (a salesman's pitch).

strings.zh: 一个人出门在外,{NEWLINE}不随身携带点道具物品,{CLEAR}恐怕难以应付漫长的旅途。{SCROLL}说起购买旅行道具,{NEWLINE}全关东地区都赫赫有名的常磐商店{CLEAR}绝对是您的不二之选！
strings.en: Heading out alone without any items? A{NEWLINE}long journey will be tough going.{SCROLL}For travel supplies, the Viridian Mart is{NEWLINE}the only choice!{SCROLL}It’s famous all over Kanto!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『呃,如果有需要,我会去的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Uh... I’ll go if I need{NEWLINE}anything.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position; ext-review RV-010

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『做生意可不只是动动嘴啊{NEWLINE}去常磐商店购物的话有什么优惠吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Talk is cheap, you know. Any{NEWLINE}discounts if I shop at the Viridian Mart?

strings.zh: 哈哈,您不需要犹豫,{NEWLINE}常磐商店的道具绝对物超所值。
strings.en: Ha ha, no need to hesitate! Viridian{NEWLINE}Mart items are well worth the price.

strings.zh: 为了表示我们的诚意{NEWLINE}请您先收下这个！
strings.en: To show you we mean it, please accept{NEWLINE}this first!

strings.zh: 这是我们常磐商店{NEWLINE}最畅销的树果汁！{CLEAR}营养美味,对精灵的身体也好。{SCROLL}如果觉得对您旅途有帮助,{NEWLINE}欢迎到常磐商店采购！
strings.en: It’s the Viridian Mart’s best-selling{NEWLINE}Berry Juice!{CLEAR}Tasty, healthy and good for Pokémon!{SCROLL}If it helps you on your journey, come{NEWLINE}stock up at the Viridian Mart!

strings.zh: 啊！是镇上的{VAR:0103:0}哥！{NEWLINE}偷偷告诉你,{SCROLL}我有自己的精灵了！
strings.en: Oh! It’s Big Bro {VAR:0103:0} from town!{SCROLL}Want to know a secret? I’ve got my own{NEWLINE}Pokémon now!
strings.notes: Wade (光一), male-player variant. | RV010: omission: 哥 honorific kept

strings.zh: 啊！是镇上的{VAR:0103:0}姐！{NEWLINE}偷偷告诉你,{SCROLL}我有自己的精灵了！
strings.en: Oh! It’s Big Sis {VAR:0103:0} from town!{SCROLL}Want to know a secret? I’ve got my own{NEWLINE}Pokémon now!
strings.notes: Wade (光一), female-player variant. | RV010: omission: 姐 honorific kept

strings.zh: 我偷偷跑出来玩的事{NEWLINE}不要告诉镇上人哟！
strings.en: Don’t tell anyone in town I snuck out to{NEWLINE}play, okay?

strings.zh: 梦幻『Me……Mew……
strings.en: Mew: Me... Mew...

strings.zh: 这只口袋妖怪似乎受伤了……
strings.en: This Pokémon seems to be hurt...

strings.zh: 梦幻『Mew！！！{SCROLL}梦幻的叫声有些凄厉……
strings.en: Mew: Mew!!!{SCROLL}Mew’s cry sounds pained...

strings.zh: 跑掉了……
strings.en: It ran away...

strings.zh: 小蓝『真新镇附近{NEWLINE}会有什么特别的精灵吗……
strings.en: Green: I wonder if there are any special{NEWLINE}Pokémon around Pallet Town...

strings.zh: 小赤『首先要丰富一下队伍的构成。
strings.en: Red: First, I need to fill out my team a{NEWLINE}bit.

strings.zh: 小蓝『又是小拉达啊,{NEWLINE}看来得换个地方试试了。
strings.en: Green: Rattata again? Guess I’d better{NEWLINE}try somewhere else.

strings.zh: 小赤『普通系的小拉达啊,{NEWLINE}虽然不能克制其他属性,{CLEAR}却也很少受到克制,{CLEAR}也算不错啦。
strings.en: Red: A Normal-type Rattata, huh.{CLEAR}It doesn’t have an edge on any type,{NEWLINE}but hardly anything has an edge on it{CLEAR}either. Not bad!

strings.zh: 哦？你想向我挑战吗？{NEWLINE}我只跟有实力的训练家对战。{CLEAR}以你现在的水平我没有兴趣。
strings.en: Oh? You want to challenge me?{CLEAR}I only battle strong Trainers. At your{NEWLINE}level, I’m not interested.

strings.zh: 大哥哥就教教我如何抓精灵吧！{SCROLL}我也想跟精灵做朋友！
strings.en: Big Bro, please teach me how to catch{NEWLINE}Pokémon!{SCROLL}I want to be friends with Pokémon too!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | RV010: omission: 大哥哥 address kept

strings.zh: 小蓝『好嘞,{NEWLINE}姐姐这就给你示范一下！
strings.en: Green: Sure thing! Big Sis will show you{NEWLINE}how right now!
strings.notes: v3 had the wrong label (Blue). | RV010: voice: 姐姐 self-reference kept

strings.zh: 小赤『小意思,包在我身上！
strings.en: Red: Easy. Leave it to me!

strings.zh: 小蓝『来,{NEWLINE}把它收下吧！
strings.en: Green: Here, it’s yours!

strings.zh: 小赤『给,从现在起你们就是朋友了！
strings.en: Red: Here. From now on, you two are{NEWLINE}friends!

strings.zh: 哇！{NEWLINE}这……真的可以吗？
strings.en: Wow! Is... is this really okay?

strings.zh: 哇！大哥哥要把小拉达送给我吗？
strings.en: Wow! Big Bro, you’re giving me Rattata?
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | RV010: omission: 大哥哥 address kept

strings.zh: 小蓝『当然啦,它现在是你的伙伴了！
strings.en: Green: Of course! It’s your partner{NEWLINE}now!

strings.zh: 小赤『嘿嘿,{NEWLINE}你不是一直想要这样一个朋友吗？
strings.en: Red: Heh heh. Isn’t this the kind of{NEWLINE}friend you’ve always wanted?

strings.zh: 谢谢大姐姐！我们会是永远的好朋友！
strings.en: Thank you, Big Sis! We’ll be best friends{NEWLINE}forever!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | RV010: omission: 大姐姐 address kept

strings.zh: 谢谢大哥哥！我会好好照顾小拉的！
strings.en: Thank you, Big Bro! I’ll take good care{NEWLINE}of Ratty!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | RV010: omission: 大哥哥 address and nickname 小拉 (D-0336 Ratty) kept; settles D-1781

strings.zh: 小蓝『好啦,咱们回常磐市吧！
strings.en: Green: Okay, let’s head back to Viridian{NEWLINE}City!

strings.zh: 小赤『好啦,咱们回常磐市吧！
strings.en: Red: Okay, let’s head back to Viridian{NEWLINE}City!

strings.zh: 啊！大姐姐等等我啊
strings.en: Ah! Big Sis, wait for me!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | RV010: omission: 大姐姐 address kept

strings.zh: 啊！大哥哥等等我啊
strings.en: Ah! Big Bro, wait for me!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | RV010: omission: 大哥哥 address kept

strings.zh: 你知道什么是种族值吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Do you know what base stats are?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 拉达『Rati,Rati！
strings.en: Raticate: Rati, rati!

strings.zh: 妈的滚远点！{NEWLINE}别在这里碍事！
strings.en: Damn it, get the hell out of here! Quit{NEWLINE}getting in the way!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | RV010: softened: 妈的滚远点 at full strength

strings.zh: 按照足迹来看……{NEWLINE}应该是经过这里向北去了。
strings.en: Judging by these footprints... it went{NEWLINE}north through here.

strings.zh: 火箭队正在执行任务,{NEWLINE}碍事者闪开！
strings.en: Team Rocket is on a mission! Out of the{NEWLINE}way!

strings.zh: 哈哈,没事没事。
strings.en: Ha ha, it’s fine, it’s fine.

strings.zh: 种族值是决定口袋妖怪{NEWLINE}能力值强弱的最核心因素,{CLEAR}它只跟口袋妖怪的种类相关。{SCROLL}不过种族值高的精灵虽然潜力较大,{NEWLINE}但成长和进化都相对慢一些,{CLEAR}如果是新手训练家的话,{CLEAR}使用像拉达、绿毛虫这种{CLEAR}能快速升级进化的精灵{CLEAR}也是个不错的选择。
strings.en: Base stats are the key to how strong a{NEWLINE}Pokémon’s stats are.{SCROLL}They depend only on its species.{SCROLL}Pokémon with high base stats have more{NEWLINE}potential...{SCROLL}...but they grow and evolve more{NEWLINE}slowly.{SCROLL}For new Trainers, fast-growing Pokémon{NEWLINE}like Rattata and Caterpie are good too.
strings.notes: D-1195: reverted to match the zh (Names 拉达 (Raticate) as a fast-evolving beginner Pokémon next to Caterpie); logged in hack_findings_import.jsonl | Hack text error fixed with user approval (D-0527, D-1496).

strings.zh: 这么说来你是一个{NEWLINE}很有经验的训练家啊。
strings.en: So you’re a pretty experienced Trainer,{NEWLINE}huh?

strings.zh: 看到前面的台阶了吗？{NEWLINE}虽然无法从下面上来,{CLEAR}但是从这里跳下去的话,{CLEAR}就可以避开草丛,很快地到达真新镇。
strings.en: See the ledge up ahead? You can’t climb{NEWLINE}it from below.{CLEAR}But if you jump down from here, you can{CLEAR}skip the grass and get to Pallet Town{CLEAR}fast.

strings.zh: 九尾『Niii——tal！
strings.en: Ninetales: Niii-tales!

strings.zh: 我能感受到{NEWLINE}你身为训练家的强大气场,{CLEAR}你愿意跟我来一场对战吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I can sense a powerful aura about you{NEWLINE}as a Trainer.{CLEAR}Will you battle me?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你不渴望与强者交手吗？
strings.en: Don’t you long to face strong{NEWLINE}opponents?

strings.en: Whichever it is, I won’t lose. Bring it{NEWLINE}on!

strings.en: You’re really strong.

strings.en: Mew: Meeee-ew!
